answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a crystal-clear escrow before trading, like yarrow roots anchoring a plant in thin tundra soil. The stake is slashed if the agent cheats or floods the network with fake identities, while honest work earns it back with fees. An attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake identity, so a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds while earning nothing, making the attack far more expensive than any gain.
